version.description: Semantic version. Installing one with the same id and a higher version updates it.

sdk.description: Version of the SDK it was built against («1.21»). Same major number as K-Desktop's and a minor one no higher = compatible.

entry.description: Assembly and type that implements IAssistant: «lib/File.dll!Name.Space.Type». Or, for an assistant without code, its character.json (character.schema.json): the host moves it with its pictures.

wakeWord.description: Suggested name to call it by. On install, K-Desktop offers to record it with the user's voice.

model.description: Suggested AI model: one or several of Hugging Face («owner/repo/file.gguf» or «owner/repo:Q4_K_M»), the best first. K-Desktop offers the first one that fits in the graphics card; it never downloads it without asking.

think.description: Suggested model to think harder with («think it over», or when it asks for it itself): like «suggested». K-Desktop offers it apart, unticked; without one, it thinks harder with its usual model.

persona.description: Personality and lines. It can carry «{lang}» (persona/{lang}.json); if the user's language is not there, English or the first one there is.

gestures.description: Gestures it can perform (communicate and react are always taken as known).

common.description: Common settings it takes: K-Desktop shows them in the «Basics» tab of its card and passes them in IAssistantHost.Common (the volume is applied by the host). One without code takes them all.

speech.description: Who draws what it says: «host» (the default), K-Desktop's bubble; «own», the assistant itself with IAssistant.ShowSpeech (when it cannot, or when the user asks for it on its card, K-Desktop's bubble shows). One without code always uses K-Desktop's.

extras.description: Its own actions, which show as «Assistant: action» in K-Desktop's commands, in its right-click menu and in its panel.

hotkey.description: Shortcut K-Desktop offers to create on install.

updates.description: URL of the latest package (.kai) to check for updates (https; http only to localhost or 127.0.0.1, for testing).

changes.description: What this version brings: K-Desktop shows it when offering it as an update and on its card.

showcase.description: Short clips of its showcase, for the catalog: K-Desktop shows them without loading its code. «item» is the id of what it shows: one of K-Desktop's (enter.summoned, state.thinking, react.success, gesture.announce, window.move — the window ones need sdk 1.21 —…) or one of its own from IAssistant.Showcase, which needs «name». Recorded by the SDK's .targets with AssistantShowcase=true.

clip.description: An animated WebP, a GIF or a PNG of the package (8 MB at most).

name.description: Its name, only for its own ones.

importFrom.description: Data of a standalone version K-Desktop can offer to import (paths with environment variables).

hfModel.description: A model of Hugging Face: «owner/repo/file.gguf» or «owner/repo:QUANTIZATION».
